info.title: OwnClipboard API
info.description: Client API for OwnClipboard. Authenticated endpoints expect the JWT from `/auth/login` in the `oc-token` header.

tags.name: Subscription
tags.description: Pro plan subscriptions paid through NowPayments.

tags.name: Devices
tags.description: Api keys used by external apps through the legacy api.

tags.name: Files

tags.description: Endpoints that need no authentication (public paste).

tags.name: Legacy
tags.description: Api of the first OwnClipboard platform, served at `/api/*` so existing apps keep working. Authenticated with a device api key sent as the `oc-key` header, an `api_key` query param or an `api_key` body field, never with the jwt.

ocToken.name: oc-token
ocToken.description: JWT returned by `POST /client/v1/auth/login`. The old `oc_token` spelling is still accepted but is dropped by nginx, which strips headers containing underscores.

field.description: Name of the request field that failed validation, when applicable.

InvoiceStatus.description: NowPayments payment statuses plus our own `pending` (invoice created, no payment started yet). See https://documenter.getpostman.com/view/7907941/2s93JusNJt#payment-statuses

duration.description: Number of months or years, 1 to 5.

invoice.description: Hosted invoice to redirect the user to.

subscription.description: Latest active subscription. May be expired, check `expired`.

pending.description: Pending (unpaid) subscriptions with their invoices, newest first.

folder.description: Slug of the folder the clip is in.

context.description: The clip content. Ciphertext when `encrypted` is true. Always "File Clip" for file clips.

file.description: Present on file clips (`type` is `file`). The file name is the default title; size is on the clip.

ext.description: Lower-cased extension without the dot, empty when none.

FileSummary.description: File reference embedded in a clip.

query.description: The trimmed search query that was used.

ids.description: `publicId`s of the clips to copy or move, 1 to 100.

folder.description: Target folder name or slug. Must not be an encrypted folder.

merged.description: Clips that already existed in the target: the existing clip was touched and the source deleted.

copied.description: Clips copied, with the `publicId` of each new copy.

merged.description: Clips that already existed in the target: the existing clip was touched.

AuthUser.description: Public view of the authenticated user.

storage.description: File storage of the account, for deciding whether to offer uploads.

connected.description: Whether files can be uploaded right now.

default.description: True when the storage in use is the app's default one, not the user's own server.

defaultAvailable.description: Whether this server offers a default storage at all.

proRequired.description: Set when the user picked the default storage but is no longer Pro. `connected` is false until they renew or connect their own server.

StorageSummary.description: Short view of the user's file storage. The full view is `GET account/owns3`.

token.description: JWT to send in the `oc-token` header.

email.description: Optional. Must be unique; stored trimmed and lower-cased. Used for password resets.

exists.description: Whether the username is already taken.

plan.description: Choosing `pro` for the first time starts a 7 day trial.

contents.description: Number of clips in the folder. Only present in the folder list.

publicPaste.description: Present when public paste is enabled.

name.description: Folder name, must be unique per user. The slug is derived from it.

visibility.description: `encrypted` marks a folder whose clips the client encrypts before sending. Fixed at creation, it cannot be changed afterwards. Defaults to `public`.

name.description: New folder name, up to 100 characters. The slug is derived from it.

password.description: MD5 hash (32 hex characters) of the password chosen by the user.

folder.description: Target folder name or slug. Defaults to `clipboard`.

message.description: Present when a new clip was created.

info.description: Present when identical content already existed and was only touched.

ids.description: `publicId`s of clips that were created through public paste.

info.description: Warning, e.g. the encrypted folder has no password set yet.

password.description: Required only for encrypted clips: MD5 hash of the folder password.

endpoint.description: Base url of the owns3 server, e.g. `https://owns3.example.com`.

apiKey.description: Application api key with read, write and delete permissions.

folder.description: Folder prefix the app is confined to.

default.description: True when the connected storage is the app's default one.

defaultAvailable.description: Whether the server offers a default storage (`POST account/owns3/use-default`, Pro only).

proRequired.description: Set when the user chose the default storage but is no longer Pro: `connected` is false until they renew.

default.description: True when the connected storage is the app's default one.

defaultAvailable.description: Whether the server offers a default storage (`POST account/owns3/use-default`, Pro only).

proRequired.description: Set when the user chose the default storage but is no longer Pro: `connected` is false until they renew.

files.description: Uploaded files that stay on the server and become unavailable.

title.description: Clip title, defaults to the file name.

ext.description: Lower-cased extension without the dot, empty when none.

folder.description: Slug of the folder the clip lives in.

size.description: Bytes. Declared size until confirmed, then the real size.

File.description: Public view of a file record.

name.description: Original file name, up to 255 characters.

title.description: Optional clip title. Defaults to the file name.

folder.description: Target folder name or slug. Defaults to clipboard. Encrypted folders are refused.

url.description: Presigned S3 url. PUT the raw file body here with the given headers.

email.description: Trimmed and lower-cased before saving. Must not belong to another account.

token.description: New jwt for this device. Replace the stored `oc-token` with it.

folder.description: Slug of the folder the device reads from and writes to.

enabled.description: A disabled device's key is refused by the legacy api.

hits.description: Number of legacy api calls made with this key.

keyHint.description: Last characters of the api key, to tell devices apart.

connected.description: Whether the key has been connected through the legacy `connect` endpoint.

usedBy.description: `device_id` the app sent when it connected.

Device.description: Public view of a device. The api key is never included.

max.description: Devices allowed on the current plan. `null` means unlimited.

folder.description: Folder name or slug the device uses. Defaults to clipboard. Encrypted folders are refused.

apiKey.description: 100 character api key. Shown once, only its hash is stored.

CreateDeviceResponse.description: The api key is only ever returned here, when created or rotated.

code.description: Clip id, called `code` on the old platform.

locked.description: 0 or 1, as the old sqlite rows had it.

favorite.description: 0 or 1, as the old sqlite rows had it.

html_formatted.description:
Content with html entities escaped and newlines turned into `
`.

LegacyClip.description: A clip as the first OwnClipboard platform returned it.

search.description: Echo of the `search` query, absent when none was sent.

LegacyErrorResponse.description: Error envelope of the legacy api.

post.description:
Creates a pending subscription and a NowPayments hosted invoice for it.
Redirect the user to `invoice.url` to pay. The subscription activates
through the payment webhook, usually a few minutes after payment.

If the user already has a pending subscription with the same plan, type
and duration, its existing invoice is returned instead of creating a new one.

400.description: Validation error.

502.description: NowPayments could not create the invoice.

get.description:
Returns the latest active subscription (which may already be expired,
check `expired`) and every pending subscription with its invoice, so the
client can offer "continue payment" or "cancel".

post.description:
Cancels a pending, unpaid subscription. Paid or active subscriptions cannot
be cancelled here. The NowPayments invoice itself cannot be voided; if it is
paid later anyway, the subscription is activated.

400.description: Validation error, or the subscription is not pending.

404.description: No such subscription for this user.

post.summary: Validate that this host is an OwnClipboard server
post.description:
Legacy api. Needs no api key: apps call it to confirm an endpoint belongs to
OwnClipboard before asking the user for a key.

Legacy api. A key has to be connected once before any other endpoint accepts it.
The app may send a `device_id` to tie the key to itself. The key is echoed back.
Send the key as the `oc-key` header, an `api_key` query param or an `api_key` body field.

device_id.description: Identifier of the app or machine.

get.description:
Legacy api. Returns the clips of the device's folder, newest first, 20 per page.
`search` matches the clip text and is ignored when shorter than 2 characters.
File clips are never returned.

post.description:
Legacy api. Adds a clip to the device's folder. Identical text already in that folder
is not duplicated: the existing clip is returned with `exists: true`.

delete.description:
Legacy api. `clip` is the `code` of the clip, sent as a query param or a body field.
Only clips in the device's folder can be deleted.

get.description:
Returns the authenticated user's public profile, their latest active subscription and a
short view of their file storage, so the client can decide whether to offer uploads.
`storage.connected` is true when files can be uploaded now. `storage.default` says the
app's own storage is in use, `storage.defaultAvailable` whether it is offered at all,
and `storage.proRequired` appears when the default storage is picked but the Pro plan
has lapsed. The full connection details live at `GET /client/v1/account/owns3`.

post.description: Returns a JWT. Send it as the `oc-token` header on authenticated requests.

400.description: Validation error or unknown username.

post.description:
Creates an account with the default `Clipboard` and `Encrypted` folders.
`email` is optional, must be unique, and is kept for password resets.

400.description: Validation error, username already taken, or email already in use.

post.summary: Check whether a username is taken

400.description: Invalid username.

post.description:
Ends every session of the account, on every device. The jwt carries a login token
that is compared on each request, and this endpoint replaces it, so all tokens
issued so far stop working. The client should discard its own token as well.

400.description: Invalid or already ended session.

get.description:
Whether the user has a storage connected: their own owns3 server (https://github.com/ownclipboard/owns3)
or the app's default one (`default: true`). `defaultAvailable` says whether the default option is offered.
Never returns an api key.

post.description:
Validates the endpoint and api key against owns3 `/api/v1/me`. The key must carry the
`read`, `write` and `delete` permissions. Replaces any previous connection.
The key is stored encrypted.

400.description: Invalid endpoint or the key lacks a required permission.

502.description: The owns3 endpoint could not be reached.

post.description:
Pro only. Connects the user to the owns3 storage operated by OwnClipboard, so they can
upload files without running their own server. Files are stored under the user's own
prefix. Replaces any previously connected server. Only available when the status reports
`defaultAvailable`. If the Pro subscription later expires, the status reports
`proRequired` and uploads are refused until it is renewed or an own server is connected.

503.description: The default storage is not configured or not reachable.

post.description: Removes the stored endpoint and key. Uploaded files stay on the server but cannot be downloaded or deleted until a server is connected again.

400.description: No server connected.

get.description: All folders of the user with their clip counts.

post.description:
Creates a folder. Pass `visibility: encrypted` for a folder whose clips the client
encrypts before sending. Visibility is fixed at creation and cannot be changed later,
because existing clips would be marked encrypted without being encrypted.
An encrypted folder needs a password before it is usable, set with
`POST /client/v1/folder/{folder}/set-password`. Files cannot be uploaded into an
encrypted folder, its clips cannot be copied or moved, and devices cannot use it.

400.description: Validation error or a folder with that name already exists.

post.description:
Stores the password used to encrypt clips in this folder. The client must send the
MD5 hash of the password, never the plain text. Folders with a password cannot be deleted.

400.description: Validation error.

post.description:
Renames a folder. The slug is derived from the new name, and every clip and file in
the folder is moved to the new slug, so the client must use the returned `slug` from
now on. The default `clipboard` and `encrypted` folders cannot be renamed.

400.description: Validation error, protected folder, or a folder with that name already exists.
Validation error or the folder has no password.

post.description: Generates a public paste id so anyone can paste into this folder via `/client/v1/clips/paste/{pasteId}`.

400.description: Already enabled.
Not enabled.

delete.description: Deletes the folder and every clip in it. The default `clipboard` folder and folders with a password cannot be deleted.

400.description: Folder is protected or is the default folder.

get.description: No authentication required. Resolves a public paste id to its folder.

400.description: Paste folder not found or has expired.

post.description:
Step 1 of 3. Requires a connected owns3 server. Creates a pending file record and
returns a presigned url. Step 2: `PUT` the raw file body to `upload.url` with the returned
headers (no api key needed). Step 3: call confirm. Encrypted folders are refused.
The clip's title is `title` when given, otherwise the file name; its content is always "File Clip".

400.description: No owns3 server connected, validation error, or encrypted folder.

502.description: owns3 could not be reached or refused the request.

post.description:
Step 3 of 3. Verifies the object exists on owns3, records its real size and type, and
creates a clip of type `file` (content "File Clip") whose `file` field holds the file id and extension. Calling it again
returns the existing clip with `info`.

400.description: Not uploaded yet, no owns3 server connected, or the folder no longer exists.

get.description: Presigned url valid for one hour, fetched directly from the user's storage without an api key.

400.description: Not uploaded yet or no owns3 server connected.

post.description: Deletes the object on owns3, the file record and its clip. Deleting a file clip through the clip delete endpoint does the same.

400.description: No owns3 server connected.

get.description:
Every device of the user, newest first, with how many of the plan's devices are used.
Api keys are never returned, only the last characters of each key (`keyHint`).

post.description:
Creates a device and returns its api key. The key is shown **once**: only its hash is
stored, so a lost key has to be rotated. Free accounts may have 3 devices, Pro unlimited.
The device reads and writes clips in one folder, `clipboard` by default. Encrypted
folders are refused.

200.description: Device created, with its api key.

400.description: Validation error or encrypted folder.

403.description: Device limit of the plan reached.

post.description:
Sets the folder the device reads from and writes to through the legacy api.
Encrypted folders are refused. Clips already created stay where they are.

400.description: Unknown or encrypted folder.

post.description:
Replaces the device's api key and returns the new one **once**. The old key stops
working immediately, and the app has to call the legacy `connect` endpoint again.
A disabled key is refused by the legacy api exactly like an unknown one.

delete.description: The api key stops working. Clips the device created stay.

post.description:
No authentication required. Returns clips that were created through public paste,
looked up by their ids. Meant for the paster to see the clips they submitted.

200.description: Matching clips, newest first. Empty page when `ids` is empty.

400.description: Validation error.

post.description:
Creates a clip in a folder. In non-encrypted folders identical content is de-duplicated:
the existing clip's `updatedAt` is touched instead of creating a new one.
Clips pasted into an encrypted folder are stored as-is and flagged `encrypted`, so the
client must encrypt the content before sending it.

400.description: Validation error or unknown folder.

post.description:
No authentication required. Pastes into the folder that owns `pasteId`
(see enable public paste). Identical content is de-duplicated.

400.description: Validation error, or paste folder not found / expired.

get.summary: List clips in the default folder

200.description: Clips, newest first. `info` warns when an encrypted folder has no password yet.

post.description:
Copies up to 100 clips into a folder. Requires an active Pro subscription.

- The target folder must belong to the user and must not be encrypted.
- Clips in encrypted folders are skipped (`encrypted`).
- Clips already in the target folder are skipped (`same_folder`).
- File clips are skipped (`file`): owns3 has no server-side copy. Move them instead.
- If the target already holds a clip with identical content it is merged:
  the existing clip is touched instead of creating a duplicate.

200.description: Per-clip results. Skipped ids do not fail the request.

400.description: Validation error, unknown folder, or encrypted target folder.

post.description:
Moves up to 100 clips into a folder.

- The target folder must belong to the user and must not be encrypted.
- Clips in encrypted folders are skipped (`encrypted`).
- Clips already in the target folder are skipped (`same_folder`).
- If the target already holds a clip with identical content it is merged:
  the existing clip is touched and the source clip is deleted.

200.description: Per-clip results. Skipped ids do not fail the request.

400.description: Validation error, unknown folder, or encrypted target folder.

get.description:
Case-insensitive substring search across the user's clips.
`title` is searched on every clip; `content` only on clips that are not
encrypted, because encrypted content is ciphertext.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Text to search for. Treated literally, not as a regex.

parameters.name: folder
parameters.description: Restrict results to this folder slug.

400.description: Missing or too long `q`.

post.description: Only `title` and `content` can be changed. Requires an active Pro subscription.

400.description: Validation error.

post.description: Encrypted clips require the MD5 hash of their folder password in the body.

400.description: Wrong folder password.

post.description:
Sets the user's plan. Choosing `pro` creates a 7 day trial subscription.
Paid Pro time is bought through `/client/v1/account/subscribe`.

400.description: Validation error or plan already set.

post.summary: Set or change the account email
post.description:
Adds an email to an account that has none, or replaces the one it has. The account
password is required, because the address is what a future password reset is sent to.
The address is trimmed, lower-cased and must not belong to another account.
It is not verified, so treat it as unconfirmed until a verification flow exists.

400.description: Validation error, wrong password, or the address belongs to another account.

post.description:
Replaces the password. The current one is required. Every other session is ended,
so a new token is returned for the caller: replace the stored `oc-token` with it,
otherwise the next request fails with a session error.

200.description: Password changed, with a fresh token.

400.description: Validation error, wrong current password, or the new password is the same.
